raw_segments.text: Raskolnikov took his cap and went out of the room, still pondering. It was the first time
for a long while that he had felt clear in his mind, at least.
I must settle S. Vidrigalov, he thought, and as soon as possible, he, too, seems to be
waiting for me to come to him of my own accord. And at that moment, there was such a rush
of hate in his weary heart that he might have killed either of those too poor fiery or S.
Vidrigalov. At least he felt that he would be capable of doing it later, if not now.
